name: LFS employed persons to employment_count
description: Take the LFS employed-persons count for a PSOC group unchanged. No redistribution across finer occupations is permitted.
notes: Source-specific transformation; classification, denominator and missing-value checks apply.

name: OWS average monthly basic pay to wage_basic_pay
description: Take the OWS average monthly basic pay for an occupation unchanged. Carries the OWS establishment universe and its exclusions.
notes: Source-specific transformation; classification, denominator and missing-value checks apply.

name: SOF OFW counts to distribution share
description: Divide the OFW count for a major occupation group by the total OFW count across all groups. This is P(occupation | OFW). It is NOT the share of an occupation's workers who are OFWs.
notes: Source-specific transformation; classification, denominator and missing-value checks apply.

name: O*NET Job Zone as a US proxy
description: Carry the US Job Zone across a reviewed crosswalk. Remains proxy-derived and carries the crosswalk quality.
notes: Source-specific transformation; classification, denominator and missing-value checks apply.

name: SOF published percentage as share
description: PSA Table 2 percentage and standard error divided by 100 by the parser; no re-estimation, no renormalisation, no domestic denominator.
notes: Source-specific transformation; classification, denominator and missing-value checks apply.

name: Identity
description: Value published exactly as the source published it.
notes: Identity preserves the source value; derivation and authority remain separate metadata.

name: PSOC structure entry
description: Import the pinned official 2022 PSOC workbook when verified; otherwise retain the explicitly unverified aggregate skeleton.
notes: Every output row carries verification_status; workbook completeness discrepancy is retained in notes.

name: Unweighted task score aggregation
description: Median and category distribution across task scores.
notes: Ordinal-safe primary aggregation; arithmetic mean is diagnostic only.

name: Importance-weighted task score aggregation
inputs: per-task scores, O*NET task importance ratings
notes: Reported alongside, not instead of, the unweighted variant.

name: Cross-run median
notes: Disagreement is retained and published, not collapsed away.

name: REMOVED: group total split by title keywords
description: v1 split a hard-coded PSOC major group employment total across detailed occupations using regex title multipliers.
notes: Prohibited. Recorded so the removal is explicit. Produced 43 distinct values across 173 occupations; 150 rows shared a value with another row.

name: REMOVED: category constant broadcast
description: v1 assigned one wage and one informality value per internal category, and one OFW value per PSOC major group, to every occupation in it.
notes: Prohibited. A broad-group value may be shown at a finer display granularity only when source_granularity is recorded and the interface states the mismatch.
